spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({host=~"$host", unit=~"$unit"} | json | __error__="" | PRIORITY =~ "[0-3]" [1h])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Errors by Unit
spec.description: Empty is good. Across every journald host the estate produces a few dozen lines a day at PRIORITY 0-4 in total, so a flat set of zero bars is the normal reading.

spec.expr: sum by (unit) (count_over_time({host=~"$host", unit=~"$unit"} | json | __error__="" | PRIORITY =~ "[0-3]" [$__auto])) or sum by (unit) (count_over_time({host=~"$host", unit=~"$unit"}[$__range])) * 0

spec.title: Journald Source Buffer Utilization
spec.description: Current source-buffer utilization by VM; observe the baseline before setting alert thresholds.

spec.expr: sum by (host) (rate({host=~"$host", unit=~"$unit"}[$__auto])) or sum by (host) (count_over_time({host=~"$host", unit=~"$unit"}[$__range])) * 0
sum by (unit) (rate({host=~"$host", unit=~"$unit"}[$__auto])) or sum by (unit) (count_over_time({host=~"$host", unit=~"$unit"}[$__range])) * 0

spec.title: Logs Received by VM (24h)
spec.description: A zero means Loki received no journald logs from that expected VM in the last 24 hours.

spec.title: Loki Buffer Events
spec.description: Current events queued in the in-memory Loki sink buffers. Observe the baseline before alerting.

spec.title: Reporting VMs (24h)
spec.description: Expected Vector-enabled VMs with at least one journald log received by Loki in the last 24 hours.

spec.expr: ((sum(count_over_time({host="hermes1", unit=~".+"}[24h])) or vector(0)) > bool 0) + ((sum(count_over_time({host="idp1", unit=~".+"}[24h])) or vector(0)) > bool 0) + ((sum(count_over_time({host="netbox1", unit=~".+"}[24h])) or vector(0)) > bool 0) + ((sum(count_over_time({host="openbao1", unit=~".+"}[24h])) or vector(0)) > bool 0) + ((sum(count_over_time({host="openclaw1", unit=~".+"}[24h])) or vector(0)) > bool 0) + ((sum(count_over_time({host="pdm1", unit=~".+"}[24h])) or vector(0)) > bool 0) + ((sum(count_over_time({host="runner1", unit=~".+"}[24h])) or vector(0)) > bool 0) + ((sum(count_over_time({host="toolbox1", unit=~".+"}[24h])) or vector(0)) > bool 0) + ((sum(count_over_time({host="vpngw", unit=~".+"}[24h])) or vector(0)) > bool 0)

spec.title: VM Log Activity
spec.description: Receiving means at least one log arrived in the preceding 15 minutes. Quiet can be normal for low-volume VMs.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({host=~"$host", unit=~"$unit"} | json | __error__="" | PRIORITY = "4" [1h])) or vector(0)
sum by (unit) (count_over_time({host=~"$host", unit=~"$unit"} | json | __error__="" | PRIORITY = "4" [$__auto])) or sum by (unit) (count_over_time({host=~"$host", unit=~"$unit"}[$__range])) * 0
